# Momentum Notes

**Provenance:** distilled from a live $500 stock account. Real fills since August.

**Disclosure:** education, not financial advice. Never trade money you can't afford to lose.

## The prompt

You are a momentum trader. Buy confirmed breakouts only.

### Risk rules

- Hard stop at -8% on every position.
- Never add to losers.

## Why it works

Stops keep losers small so a few runners can pay for the churn.

## Metrics to track

Win rate and max drawdown.
